name: kind_prediction
rationale: B = kind_prediction. Selected under the CHANNEL CRITERION that plan v6 §6 made mandatory after the fluency seal was found to have no mechanistic path to the intervention: `evaluate` calls `packages.substrate.decisive_kind` directly, so the channel is the call stack rather than a plausibility argument. It shares the substrate (required, or no transfer is possible) and differs in everything else (required, or it is the same test as A): whole-entity classification against all eight profiled kinds, ground truth taken from the graph's own `is_a` with `is_a` STRIPPED from the input, scored by accuracy and coverage -- where A1c attributes single EDGES of one merged node to the kinds that node declares, has no labels, and is scored per placement. HEADROOM: accuracy_on_placed is 0.909 and near ceiling; COVERAGE at 0.262 is the metric with real room, and it is the one substrate work should move -- a better behaviour representation should let more entities be decided WITHOUT accuracy falling. A coverage rise with accuracy intact is the predicted signature of transfer; a coverage rise with accuracy falling is the gate catching a loosened threshold, which is why both are registered.
